title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 2000 2001 Caprice Kylie Bax + 1 Bonus Magazine
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 original Playboy magazines from 2000–2001 featuring celebrity/model covers and interviews.

Included:

* March 2000 – Caprice — Caprice cover/pictorial, Jon Stewart interview, Cindy Margolis and Mardi Gras 2000
* August 2000 – Darva Conger — Darva Conger cover/pictorial, John Malkovich interview and Aimee Mann
* March 2001 – Kylie Bax — Supermodel Kylie Bax cover/pictorial, Bobby Knight interview and Ridley Scott
* September 2001 – Jerri Manthey / Survivor — Jerri Manthey cover/pictorial, Dale Earnhardt Jr. interview, 2001 NFL preview and Kurt Cobain feature

All are original newsstand issues with UPC/barcode covers.

Pre-owned vintage condition with normal signs of age, storage and handling. Covers appear to have light surface, edge and corner wear. Overall, these display nicely.

Please review all photos carefully for exact condition. You will receive the exact four magazines pictured.

Great lot for Playboy collectors, Survivor fans, model/celebrity collectors and collectors of early-2000s pop culture.
